scheduled.title: United LAX to Fort Lauderdale starts Sunday, Oct 25
scheduled.detail: UA1338 out 8:28 a.m., UA684 back 5:30 p.m., Boeing 737 MAX 9, five a week to start, per the AeroRoutes winter filing as reported.

scheduled.title: Delta LAX to Vancouver from Nov 21
scheduled.detail: Twice daily on the A319, per Cirium data as reported. Delta also lists West Palm Beach (Nov 23) from LAX.

news.title: Santa Ana winds flipped San Diego's runway Friday, with a ground stop and delays
news.detail: The FAA held SAN-bound flights from 8:26 a.m. Friday, Oct 16, then ran a ground delay program capping arrivals at 22 an hour as the airport switched to Runway 9. Parts of San Diego County are under a high wind warning through Saturday, so check with your airline.

news.title: Menzies Aviation files to lay off 137 at LAX effective Nov 19
news.detail: A California WARN Act notice lists 137 permanent layoffs at the ground handler's LAX operation. The filing does not say which roles are affected.

news.title: New Hollywood Burbank terminal is open
news.detail: The $1.3 billion, 14-gate terminal opened Tuesday, Oct 13, on the opposite side of the airfield. The main entrance moved to Winona Avenue and Hollywood Way, Lot E closed, and rideshare pickup moved to a new lot near the terminal.

news.title: American tests snack pre-orders on DFW to LAX from Oct 20
news.detail: Travelers on Dallas Fort Worth to LAX flights can reserve buy-on-board food items in the app or online from seven days to 20 hours before departure.

news.title: Alaska adds San Diego to Loreto from Dec 19
news.detail: Twice weekly (Wed, Sat) on SkyWest-operated Embraer 175s through April 28, 2027. Alaska says it is the airline's 50th nonstop from SAN.

news.title: Delta adds LAX to Monterey Dec 19 and LAX to Philadelphia June 7, 2027
news.detail: Monterey is twice daily on Delta Connection Embraer 175s. Philadelphia is daily on an Airbus A321neo. Delta also adds frequencies to Boston, Raleigh-Durham, San Diego and others in 2027.

news.title: Delta ends Las Vegas to San Diego on Nov 8
news.detail: Last LAS-SAN flight is Nov 8, 2026. Delta is dropping both Southern California flights from Las Vegas this winter, citing lower winter demand.

events.title: No military jet demo teams scheduled in SoCal today
events.detail: The FAA notice of 2026 military demo-team airshows shows the nearby SoCal dates, Miramar (Sep 25 to 27) and Huntington Beach (Oct 2 to 4), are done for the year.
events.source: FAA Domestic Notice, 2026 military aerial demonstration airshows

events.title: Halloween fly-in at Flabob Airport, Riverside, Sat Oct 24
events.detail: The San Diego chapter of The Ninety-Nines is hosting a costume fly-in lunch at the Flabob Airport Cafe (KRIR), 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Pilots can fly in and drivers are welcome. RSVP on the chapter page.

events.title: EAA Chapter 1116 Young Eagles kickoff, Thermal, Sat Oct 17
events.detail: Free intro flights for ages 8 to 17, 8:00 to 10:30 a.m. at Thermal Aviation Hangar 2. Waitlist registration on the chapter page; a waitlist spot is not a confirmed flight.

events.title: AKROFEST 2026 at Borrego Valley Airport, Oct 22 to 24
events.detail: IAC Chapter 36 competition: practice Thu Oct 22, contest Fri-Sat Oct 23-24. Public spectator access not confirmed; check the organizer before planning to attend.

audio.transcript:
Good morning, SoCal. This is the Aircraft Aviation daily brief for Saturday, October 17. You are hearing a narrated test voice, not Ben.

Our 6:01 AM PT, 6:11 AM PT, 6:21 AM PT snapshot caught 115 aircraft over Southern California. Heavy metal: FedEx McDonnell Douglas MD-11 N643FE, on the ground at LAX. Heavy metal: Qantas Airbus A380 VH-OQB, low near LAX (5,800 ft). Heavy metal: Boeing 767-400 N842MH, on the ground at LAX. Widebody at SAN: FedEx Boeing 767-300 N247FE, on the ground at SAN.

No military jet demo teams scheduled in SoCal today.

In the news: Santa Ana winds flipped San Diego's runway Friday, with a ground stop and delays.

That's the board. Clear skies, and happy spotting.
